approach_explanation: We cleaned 350 test records with train-fitted medians and kept every row in input order, adding 45 thermal-consistency features. A gradient-boosting validity classifier (Invalid F1 0.925) flagged 38 records as Invalid, separating sensor faults from genuine regime shifts. A second gradient-boosting model (RMSE 1.07) predicted Reference_Parameter for all rows from 13.1 to 59.4 (avg 26.4). Attention blends anomaly score with decision-borderline closeness; highest attention: TST-0172, TST-0275, TST-0037.
